product.family: HQL LED Filament Value (LED replacement for HQL lamps in design-oriented outdoor applications)
product.description: the lamp of a post-top globe lantern: one LED lamp in a frosted ellipsoid full-glass bulb, E27, 2700 K, made to replace a mercury (HQL) lamp in open or closed outdoor luminaires in streets, pedestrian zones and parks; the globe (0.48 across, Lamberts cased opal), its cup and the cast post are the stage's own pieces, in Matter's glass and bronze
product.codeBasis: the maker's product name (827: Ra 80, 2700 K); EAN 4099854853340
product.status: current (it replaces the 38 W version, EAN 4099854071850, now discontinued)

light.fluxBasis: lamp: one bare lamp; the globe's cased opal, drawn by the stage, passes its light on
light.beamName: all round, from a frosted ellipsoid bulb at the centre of its globe

electrical.supply: 220 to 240 V mains, or the conventional control gear of the HQL lamp it replaces
electrical.control: not dimmable: switched at dusk and dawn

housing.dimensionBasis: the lamp, 90 x 217 mm, as the maker lists it
housing.materials: frosted ellipsoid full-glass bulb, E27 cap, inside a cased opal globe
housing.mounting: E27 lampholder in the globe's cup on the post, cap down

photometricFile.note: The lamp lights all round; the cased opal globe that spreads it is Matter's glass, drawn by the stage.

sources.title: LEDVANCE, HQL LED FILAMENT VALUE 5400LM 32W 827 E27 (EAN 4099854853340): 5400 lm, 32 W, 2700 K, Ra 80, 360 deg, 90 x 217 mm, 170 g, IP65, not dimmable, 25 000 h, -20 to +50 C; streets, area lighting, pedestrian zones, parks
leuchtmittel-verkauf.de, LEDVANCE HQL LED FILAMENT V 5400LM 38W 827 E27 (EAN 4099854071850, discontinued): the same lamp's earlier version, 'frosted, ellipsoid full glass bulb'

unverified: The lamp's distribution: the maker publishes a 360 degree beam and offers photometric data on its page, which was not read; the record takes it as lighting all round.
The grounds' sheet asks 2700 K and CRI of 80 or more; the as-built lamps were 2800 K.
